calendar.dailyRouteSeeds: shared across accounts by calendar date

source.limitation: Gross template creation before salvage/equipment use; shared calendar, first30 days only. No behavior, bot profile, server authority or mature-year observation.

assumptions.eligibility: Gross eligible creation is not unconsumed inventory. Canonical CHAIN policy hash matches C2 snapshot; C2 runtime differs from this checkout and is pinned, not falsely remeasured.
assumptions.time: First4 observed weeks + actual2 days in week5; missing days31-35 have zero new supply. Week6+ explicitly extrapolates overall mean or week4, or stops. No measured calendar variation.
assumptions.humans: C2 casual3.5, regular7, heavy21 hours/active week map to casual/regular/farmer.90% token-model weekly activity remains an assumption.
assumptions.bots: No measured C2 bot profile. Heavy yield×1 or×3 at assumed70 hours tests bounds; none is calibrated.
assumptions.stock: Gross creation before C2 salvage/use is optimistically offered to chain. No replay of ownership, soft-currency budgets or every item history beyond the source experiment.
assumptions.sinks: Three styles at4 and three forge designs at3+two sealed Epics; both compete for one wallet balance.50% interest and complete-recipe saving are assumptions. Existing fees/grants untouched.
assumptions.inference: Three fresh seeds quantify conditional simulation variation only. No causal, behavioral or population confidence claim. Preserve original cumulative<=2, farming<=3, seasonal>=1 and completion separately.
